디모데후서 3:1.content: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.

디모데후서 3:2.content: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

디모데후서 3:3.content: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,

디모데후서 3:4.content: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;

디모데후서 3:5.content: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.

디모데후서 3:6.content: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,

디모데후서 3:7.content: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

디모데후서 3:8.content: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.

디모데후서 3:9.content: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as theirs also was.

디모데후서 3:10.content: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,

디모데후서 3:11.content: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.

디모데후서 3:12.content: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

디모데후서 3:13.content: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.

디모데후서 3:14.content: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;

디모데후서 3:15.content: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

디모데후서 3:16.content: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:

디모데후서 3:17.content: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.
